title: Pregnant Trio #29
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with sapphires in brass-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of mixed-metal a bracelet. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme cream extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Norwegian, in her mid 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, deep dark brown hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real pores, real living eyes, 50 hoops piercings set with diamonds in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a bracelet. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic, a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide ochre bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of spiral floral bands wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme ochre extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Japanese, in her late 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a professional female bodybuilder physique, carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps, wide flaring lats, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep — and projecting forward from her hard, muscular middle, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its surface taut and round even where the muscle around it stays hard and defined. Diamond-shaped calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer, a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide silver chrome bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of zigzag linework wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, extreme silver chrome extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
